resources.string: Some TV firmware intercepts branded buttons before Android can learn them. The four app redirects below open your chosen app whenever the original app opens, including manual launches. Add a button learns other detectable buttons.
This replaces all openings of this original app, including its remote button and manual launches. Restore original button action turns the redirect off.
Enable the button helper to remap buttons from any app
Choose Add a button, press its real remote button, then choose an app. Home, Back, volume, power and navigation keep their normal actions. Some firmware-controlled buttons may not be remappable.
Which button are you setting up?
Press the %1$s button now. Press Back to cancel.
